title: On Occupying the whole north wing
subtitle: 城市生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 城市生活（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·城市生活）
meta: 主题语境：城市生活（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·城市生活）　|　核心词汇：occupy　|　正文 337 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 occupy 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1981 the herder ① occupied the whole north wing on the same day, and every neighbour in the pasture said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three winters on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the herder ② occupies the whole north wing before dawn without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ occupy the whole north wing at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ occupied the whole north wing before — a line in the ledger for December 1975 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Occupying the whole north wing on the same day, the herder said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the rope at the far pen, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ occupy their thoughts for years before dawn, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Occupy their thoughts for years at once and never mention it again.

By 1988 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the ledger, and a new neighbour from the next pasture ⑧ occupies their thoughts for years on the same day every winter without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the pen, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ occupied the whole north wing again when nobody else would.

⑩ To occupy the whole north wing, my mother said in 1993, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the pasture remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the pasture forgets, somebody occupies the whole north wing before dawn again and somebody must occupy the whole north wing on the same day all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 占用（一般过去式 occupied the whole north wing：1981 年牧人头一回这样做，当天就）
B. v. 占用（一般现在 occupies the whole north wing：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 占用（不定式 to occupy the whole north wing：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 占用（过去完成时 had occupied the whole north wing：1975 年十二月的牧群台账上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 占用（动名词 occupying the whole north wing 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 占据（occupy their thoughts for years：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去占据占据他们心思好几年）
G. v. 占据（occupy their thoughts for years：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 占用（后段两处：新来的邻人照例 occupies their thoughts for years，而母亲又一次 occupied the whole north wing）

items.q: to occupy the whole north wing
occupied the whole north wing before
occupy their thoughts for years before dawn
occupy their thoughts for years at once
occupies their thoughts for years on the same day
occupied the whole north wing again
to occupy the whole north wing

answers.why: occupy 意为“占用”，1981 年牧人当天就占用占用了整个北翼，那是牧场里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 occupied。
occupy 意为“占用”，自那以后牧人天没亮就把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 occupies。
occupy 意为“占用”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯占用占用了整个北翼”，此处为不定式 to occupy the whole north wing。
occupy 意为“占用”，牧群台账里 十二月 那行字说明早在 1988 年之前就有人占用过，故用过去完成时 had occupied。
occupy 意为“占用”，牧人说“占用占用了整个北翼这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 occupying the whole north wing 作主语。
occupy 意为“占据”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去占据占据他们心思好几年”，should ever 之后用原形 occupy their thoughts for years。
occupy 意为“占据”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻占据占据他们心思好几年（occupy their thoughts for years at once），以后再也不要提起。
occupy 意为“占用”，新来的邻人每个冬天都照例占据占据他们心思好几年，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 occupies。
occupy 意为“占用”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次当天就占用占用了整个北翼，用一般过去式 occupied 叙述。
occupy 意为“占用”，结尾那句是母亲 1993 年的话：要占用占用了整个北翼，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和牧场记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用

items: 1981 年，牧人当天就占用占用了整个北翼；牧场里每一个邻人都说这是头一回。（occupied the whole north wing）
多年以后，牧人仍天没亮就做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（occupies the whole north wing）

牧人说过，当天就占用占用了整个北翼这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（occupying the whole north wing 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻占据占据他们心思好几年，以后再也不要提起。（occupy their thoughts for years，祈使句）

Three winters on, the herder still occupies the whole north wing before dawn without being asked.

Occupying the whole north wing on the same day, the herder said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 occupy 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1981 the herder occupied the whole north wing on the same day, and nobody in the pasture forgot it.
Even now the herder occupies the whole north wing before dawn whenever the pasture asks.
Occupying the whole north wing on the same day, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever occupy their thoughts for years before dawn, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new neighbour from the next pasture occupies their thoughts for years on the same day every winter, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother occupied the whole north wing again, and the pasture remembered that half.
